title: Shell Method Revolved Around the x-Axis
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the volume of the solid generated by revolving the region bounded by x = y^2 and x = 4 in the first quadrant about the x-axis using cylindrical shells.

steps.title: Identify Limits and Shell Parameters in y
steps.mathExpression: y^2 = 4 \implies y = 2; \quad r(y) = y, \quad h(y) = 4 - y^2 \quad \text{for } y \in [0, 2]
steps.explanation: Shell radius is distance from x-axis (y), and height is right curve minus left curve (4 - y^2).

steps.title: Set Up Integral in y
steps.mathExpression: V = 2\pi \int_0^2 y(4 - y^2) dy = 2\pi \int_0^2 (4y - y^3) dy
steps.why: Shell method formula for rotation about x-axis.
